pricing.source: Official page https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, read by the project on 2026-10-10 (base input/output tokens, global routing, no caching, no batch discount); the rate for prompts up to 100,000 tokens, which every FaultLab call is (32,000-token input bound)

claim: A development screen on public cases: how often this model makes the task's mistakes here. Not an unseen-case result; no repair and no policy is involved.
decision_rule: A case shows a repeated mistake when the same lowest failed check appears in at least 2 of its 3 trials. Any repeated mistake makes step 6 (a repair study on that case) worth proposing to the owner; none means no repeated mistake was found on the public cases, and it is reported that way.

monthly.rule: for this run FAULTLAB_MONTHLY_DOLLAR_CAP is lowered to this month's committed dollars plus the quoted $0.81

name: bookings-screen-1-2026-11-19
order: hk-dev-2 first (three trials, the preflight), then the other seven cases, three trials each: 24 trials in all

preflight.pass: all three executions COMPLETED with recorded dollars and under 80 seconds of wall time; every ledger row they added names the model; no answer reached 1,900 output tokens; mean cost under $0.03 a trial. A missing or invalid report is a finding of the screen, not a preflight failure. The preflight trials count as the case's three trials.

question: With Haiku 5.5 as the pack-built Actor (pack-actor) on the eight public cases of the bookings task, three trials each and no rule: which checks does it fail, and does any case show a repeated mistake (the same lowest failed check in at least 2 of its 3 trials)?
readouts: per case: the failed checks and the lowest failed check of each trial
the task's target mistakes: trials failing H2 (duplicate holding) and H3 (abandoned hold)
the oracle's false beliefs by claim
stop_rules: a billing message in any log stops the run
the preflight must PASS before the other 21 trials run
